NightAudio — preparation batch, October 11, 2026

CameraClick.wav, FlashlightSwitch.wav, ToolSetDown.wav, PanelSelect.wav and the four
OGG files in Originals derive from Interface Sounds 1.0 by Kenney (www.kenney.nl).
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The author's original notice is preserved in Originals/License.txt.
Redistribution, modification and commercial use permitted; attribution not required.
Voluntary credit: Interface Sounds by Kenney, CC0 1.0.

Exact archive URL, archive SHA256 and original member names/hashes: sources.json.
Modified by the project with Codex: mono downmix, DC removal, conservative peak
normalization and 2ms edge fades; exported as 16-bit PCM WAV. Original OGGs unchanged.
The final peak may be below -12 dBFS after the fades. These are generic interaction
sounds, not recordings of a specific camera, police radio or forensic equipment.

DistantAir_Loop.wav is original project-generated periodic filtered noise, created
with Codex in Tools/prepare_night_audio.py. No sampled recording, speech, music or
external sound input. No third-party attribution or redistribution restrictions.
